g.text: Zero-Knowledge Computational Contract Conformance & Fail-Closed Disbursal Architecture for Digital Lending (RBI & DPDP Compliant)
• Borrower Onboarding, KYC, PAN, Bank IFSC, Telecom Telemetry
• Ingests Raw Features: bureau_score, income, FOIR, behaviour_idx
• Evaluates unmasked features against secret model weights Θ
• Quantizes features to Fixed-Point 1024, orders by FEATURE_ORDER
B. EZKL Halo2 KZG SNARK Prover (circuits/prove.py)
• Proves inference execution without disclosing input witness or weights
• Generates 24 KB Halo2 KZG Proof Bytes (P50: 2.28s, P95: 3.12s)
• Computes Public Inputs Vector: (policy_hash, C, X, decision, tau, epoch)
C. Transactional Outbox & Reliable Dispatcher (SQLite Outbox)
• Guarantees At-Least-Once Delivery to Lender Node
• Step 1: POST DecisionNotice (/v1/decisions) -> Starts 10-Min SLA Clock
• Automated Exponential Backoff Retries on network disconnection
Ordered cheap-to-expensive: Memory Lookups -> Elliptic Curve Pairings (<10ms)
• Recomputes X' = SHA256(bureau_features) from Lender's independent data
• Traps Liar-Prover attack if LSP proved inference on spoofed features (Scenario 5)
• Append-only hash chain: Row_Hash[i] = SHA256(Row_Hash[i-1] || canonical(Entry[i]))
• Exportable to RBI / external auditors with independent chain integrity verify
• Direct Core Banking Integration (The Disbursal Switch)
✓ If status == 'VERIFIED' and decision == 1: Authorize Disbursal within 24 Hours
✗ If status != 'VERIFIED': STRICT DISBURSAL BLOCK (Fail-Closed, Zero INR leaves)
⏱ If SLA > 10 mins: Automatically marks EXPIRED, blocks funds, raises alert
